description: Local-only educational web surface for comparing bounded pattern-aware password estimates, random search, Grover query complexity, and Shor's separate public-key threat.

runtime.language: HTML, CSS, browser JavaScript; Python reference and local server

commands.title: Estimate Password Search Cost
commands.description: Calculate bounded pattern-aware, random-space, and Grover query-work estimates for a transient representative sample.

commands.title: Select Classical Scenario
commands.description: Choose a local illustrative attack-rate profile or enter a bounded custom rate.

commands.title: Clear Representative Sample
commands.description: Remove the transient representative sample from the input and reset the result panel.

commands.title: Read Method and Sources
commands.description: Review assumptions, limitations, threat-model separation, and primary-source links.

security.network: same-origin static assets only; optional user-initiated primary-source links
security.input_lifetime: transient browser memory; explicitly cleared on pagehide and by user action
security.audit: local contract and browser-smoke evidence only; not a formal security audit
security.human_approval: required for merge, Pages or repository settings, workflow, license, package, release, visibility, and claim changes

claim_boundaries: Heuristic educational estimate, not a cracking benchmark or breach-corpus lookup.
Grover output is query complexity only, not a quantum wall-clock forecast.
Shor and PQC content describes a separate public-key migration threat.
Local proof is not hosted CI, production readiness, production-grade status, or a formal security audit.
